senses.gloss:
शिञ्ज् शिञ्ज्, ii. 2, Ātm. To tinkle, Bhaṭṭ. 14, 4; Megh. 77 (Par.).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. शिञ्जित, Tinkling, Rām. 1, 9, 17. n. Tinkling, Ragh. 4, 56; of metallic ornaments worn as chains, rings, etc., Vikr. d. 93.

शिञ्ज शिञ्ज् + अ,
 I. m. Tinkling.
 II. f. जा, A bow-string.

शिञ्जिन् शिञ्ज् + इन्,
 I. adj. Tinkling.
 II. f. नी.
 1. A bow-string.
 2. Metallic rings worn round the toes.
